title: Dallas Theological Seminary
description:
A security audit at Dallas Theological Seminary (DTS) identified critical infrastructure vulnerabilities that led to a complete compromise. 519 GB of sensitive data was stolen.
The organization refused to cooperate, endangering its employees and students, essentially approving our leak of their files when there was an opportunity to resolve the incident and avoid it.
Organization do not care about the data of their employees and customers, they do not want to resolve the incident, and vulnerabilities in their infrastructure remain open, which will lead to another leak in the future.

Published for free. | Status: free | FREE
